import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('products/services/canadabuys-data-qa-intake')
source=root/'raw/open-government-catalogue.json'
import hashlib
raw=source.read_bytes()
data=json.loads(raw)
assert data['success']
items=[{'title':item.get('title'),'id':item.get('id'),'resources':[{'name':r.get('name'),'format':r.get('format'),'url':r.get('url')} for r in item.get('resources',[])]} for item in data['result']['results']]
out={'scope':'Discovery metadata only','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'matches':data['result']['count'],'datasets':items}
(root/'official-catalogue-navigation.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(out)[:3300])
